title: lycopus virginicus var. macrophyllus
intro: Lycopus virginicus var. macrophyllus, commonly known as Virginia water horehound, is a plant species in the mint family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including relief from respiratory issues, such as colds, coughs, and bronchitis, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Virginia water horehound include soothing irritated mucous membranes, reducing inflammation, and promoting the clearance of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
